<translated_code>
# Created by My PC on 03/10/2016.

def main():
    length = int(input())
    str_input = input()

    maxLength = 0
    countLength = 0
    countWord = 0
    checker = 0
    checkerInside = 0
    isInWordOut = False
    isInWordIn = False
    isInside = False

    index = 0

    while index < length:
        ch = str_input[index]

        if ch == '(':
            isInside = True
            checkerInside += 1
            if maxLength < countLength:
                maxLength = countLength
            countLength = 0
            isInWordOut = False
        elif ch == ')':
            isInside = False
            checkerInside = 0
            if checker > 0:
                countWord += 1
                checker = 0
        else:
            if checkerInside > 0:
                isInside = True

        if index == length:
            break

        if ch != ')' and ch != '(':
            if not isInside:
                if ch == '_':
                    if maxLength < countLength:
                        maxLength = countLength
                    countLength = 0
                    isInWordOut = False
                else:
                    isInWordOut = True

                if isInWordOut:
                    countLength += 1
            else:
                isInWordOut = False
                if ch == '_':
                    if checker > 0:
                        countWord += 1
                    checker = 0
                    isInWordIn = False
                else:
                    isInWordIn = True

                if isInWordIn:
                    checker += 1

        index += 1

    if maxLength < countLength:
        maxLength = countLength

    print(f"{maxLength} {countWord}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
